title: Add full-blob qualifier to BLOBEXT cross-validation claim
description: §2.2 (line 165) says 'Clients MAY use both mechanisms and cross-validate their results after converting encodings.' But JMAP-BLOBEXT digest:sha-256 can cover an arbitrary byte range — it is only equivalent to this document's sha256 when the range covers the full blob. The cross-validation claim is only correct for full-blob BLOBEXT digests. Add qualifier: 'when the BLOBEXT digest is requested over the full blob'.
